mapping.name: Firefox Download History
mapping.description: Each row represents Firefox download metadata recovered from the Places database, linking a source URL to a saved path, byte count, start and end times, state, and deletion flag where available. Use it to trace acquisition and correlate files with later activity. A history row does not guarantee the transfer completed or that the file was opened.
mapping.short_description: Shows Firefox downloads with source URLs, saved paths, timestamps, sizes, and deletion state.
mapping.query: SELECT moz_annos.content as target_path, moz_places.url, metadata.file_size as total_bytes, moz_annos.dateAdded/1000 as start_time_ms, metadata.end_time/1000 as end_time_ms, metadata.state, metadata.deleted FROM moz_annos JOIN moz_anno_attributes ON moz_annos.anno_attribute_id = moz_anno_attributes.id AND moz_anno_attributes.name="downloads/destinationFileURI" JOIN moz_places ON moz_places.id = moz_annos.place_id JOIN ( SELECT moz_annos.place_id, json_extract(content, '$.fileSize') as file_size, json_extract(content, '$.endTime') as end_time, json_extract(content, '$.state') as state, json_extract(content, '$.deleted') as deleted FROM moz_annos JOIN moz_anno_attributes ON moz_annos.anno_attribute_id = moz_anno_attributes.id AND moz_anno_attributes.name="downloads/metaData" ) metadata on metadata.place_id = moz_annos.place_id

field.description: local file system path where the downloaded file was saved
source URL from which the file was downloaded
total size of the downloaded file in bytes
